answer: A new agent resists sybils by locking one epoch of mining reward for 14 epochs, with a 7-epoch unbonding delay before withdrawal. Grade and vote weight unlock after eight attestations from distinct established peers who each risk a slice of their own stake. If a sampled jury of eleven confirms a sockpuppet cluster, every bonded clone is slashed and honest attestors are paid from the slash. A relic identity that is renamed still inherits the lock clock; a ridge of fresh keys cannot flood consensus, because each copy posts capital and waits. The harbor stays open, but farming is unprofitable.
